market_name: Grand Rapids–Holland, Michigan visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: A loose discovery enclosure for the two stated cores, Grand Rapids and Holland; it is not a claimed MSA boundary and deliberately excludes reviewed lakeshore destinations from the market census.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: Low-precision municipal reference points only; no parcel-level geography is represented.

cells.label: Northeast Grand Rapids / Plainfield / Knapp's Corner
South Wyoming / Cutlerville / M-6 at US-131

municipality_reference_points._disclosure: One low-precision (~2 decimal places, roughly 1 km) approximate municipal reference point per included municipality, from general public geographic knowledge. Discovery-cell coverage of every included municipality is asserted against these points by tests/pettripfinder/discovery/test_market_config.py; they are never used for any precision-dependent purpose.

_geography_hardening_note: PTF-GRAND-RAPIDS-HOLLAND-GEOGRAPHY-HARDENING-002. The first six cells mirror the corridor registry and left two included municipalities outside every cell (Comstock Park and Ada, each about 2 km beyond the nearest cell edge) and two census lodging clusters on or beyond a cell edge (ZIP 49525, Plainfield Avenue / Knapp's Corner, four census identities; ZIP 49548, south Wyoming at M-6 / US-131, nine). Four tight cells were added for exactly those places; no cell was removed, no corridor was added, and the bounds are unchanged -- they already admitted every one of these points. Cells are Overpass seed points only; corridors still classify and never generate the census.
scope_disclosure: The first six cells match the committed corridor registry; the four geography-hardening cells cover included municipalities and census lodging clusters the corridor cells missed. All cells are only future-provider-query seed points. The independent candidate ledger is the census source of truth. The completeness sweep materially added an east-side cluster; it remains suppressed pending further independent discovery and is not corridor-derived.
